answer: A payout is split and hence 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ledge schedule is applied in beacon and basalt reveals each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3212 identities would post 4262 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
